Your phone, your laptop, every AI... their chips are grown in quartz bowls, and most of that quartz comes from one small American town!
One town? What if something happened to it?
It did! In twenty twenty-four, Hurricane Helene cut off Spruce Pine, North Carolina, and the chip world held its breath.
Why does one town matter so much?
Its quartz is among the purest on Earth. Analysts say it supplies around eighty percent of the world's high-purity quartz.
Chips are cut from giant silicon crystals, grown inside quartz bowls at over fourteen hundred degrees.
Any impurity in the bowl, and the crystal is ruined.
Just two companies, Sibelco and The Quartz Corp.
Roads, rail and power were cut. Sibelco restarted about two weeks later.
Others dig in Brazil, Russia and China, but nothing matches it at scale yet.
